requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product reference names shown to customers on 123.hp.com for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series to a single, consistent name to minimize user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must operate reliably and meet intervention specifications when using all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media under different climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Product must function correctly and without mechanical failure (e.g., input tray sensor flag) when placed and operated on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer continues to function without failure when tilted 20 degrees to the left or right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when placed on a moving trolley during printing.
